description.en-US:
Retreat Timer rings a recording of three singing-bowl bells at the times of day
you choose — the signal to begin or end a sitting — so a meditation retreat
keeps running on schedule even when the teacher is not present.

Built for one job: the bells ring no matter what.

* Exact alarms via the same mechanism the stock Clock app uses, so they fire on
  time even when the device is locked, asleep, or in Doze for hours.
* A foreground service holds a wake lock and plays through the alarm stream, so
  the system cannot mute or kill the bells mid-ring.
* Alarms are re-armed automatically after a reboot, time change, or app update.
* A readiness light turns green once battery optimisation and notifications are
  set, so the teacher can leave knowing the schedule is safe.

Easy to set up:

* Tap Add bell and pick the time. The picker opens ready for typing, so any
  minute is set directly — 06:47, not just 06:45 — with a dial one tap away.
* Tap any time to edit it; toggle bells on or off; delete with one tap.
* Four bell sounds to choose from — singing bell, Tibetan E flat bowl, gong
  bowl and Satipanya — all matched to the same loudness, so switching changes
  the timbre and never the volume.
* Bell volume and talk volume are set separately, because a spoken recording
  normally has to be much louder than a bowl strike to fill the same room.
  Each has its own Test button that plays at the exact level the room will
  hear, and Test talk uses the talk that is actually coming up next.

Dharma talk library:

* Add talks from this phone, an Infomaniak kDrive public share link, or a
  podcast RSS feed — every import is downloaded into the app so playback works
  with no network at all.
* Play a talk instantly, or schedule one to play at a set time exactly like a
  bell.

No ads, no tracking, no accounts. The schedule repeats every day.
